description:
Your workouts and food, in one app.

Kinetta brings activity tracking, food logging and progress into one place. Record workouts, save meals you make often, follow your history and choose what to share.

WORKOUTS
Record outdoor runs, walks and rides with GPS. Log indoor sessions and lifting sets, follow a running plan, or import supported workouts from Apple Health. Review lifting records alongside your training history. Connect Garmin for new synced workouts; available details depend on the source.

FOOD AND KIT
Log by search, barcode or chat with Kit. Mention your weight in the same message, and review both before saving. Browse recipes, cook from them, and ask Kit about past meals and weigh-ins. Review weekly nutrition insights, including logged days and nutrient and calorie-source breakdowns. Ask Kit for an on-demand weekly review of completed local days.

PROGRESS
Explore achievement tracks for running, riding, walking/hiking, swimming and lifting: see what you've earned and what's next.

CHALLENGES
Start or join group challenges for distance, active days, workout counts, food logging days or protein-goal days. Participants see challenge totals, not individual workouts or food entries; your protein target stays private.

FRIENDS
Find friends, react to activities, share workout highlights to Instagram Stories, and leave comments. Choose Only me, Friends or Everyone for each activity. When sharing a route, you can choose whether to hide its start and end; the rest of the route can still reveal location clues. Food entries, weigh-ins and private notes are not shared.

HEALTH AND OPTIONAL AI
On iPhone, connect Apple Health to import supported workouts and, separately, body-weight readings. Choose which supported categories to allow. Kit's optional AI features require your consent before relevant food descriptions, photos or selected records are sent to the configured provider. Health and Garmin data have separate choices. Review estimates and proposed changes before confirming them.

Kinetta is for people 16 or older. Kit is for people 18 or older. An account on a Kinetta server is required; enrollment and optional services depend on that server. Some recording and Apple Health features require the iPhone app. Export your data or delete your account in Settings.
